verdicts.reason: Both garble the copy the same way: the headline runs into the green circle, the grocer tagline is wedged between the first bullet and the rest, the bullets are out of order and unevenly indented, and the can floats in empty space. A at least keeps a large, readable CTA near the bottom, but it shrinks the Solstice logo into a cramped corner next to tiny legal text. B turns the CTA into a tiny pill at the very top, above the headline, so it's buried and reads first. It also gives the logo a huge bar and blows the legal text up to body-copy size.
